joint_convention: All coordinates are original source pixels. left/right denote IMAGE left/right before facing mirror. Skeleton landmarks and semantic masks are manually fitted estimates, not extracted animation frames; body alpha is measured separately. Hidden hip/knee locations under skirt/briefcase are estimates.
region_convention: Semantic polygons/capsules are weight-fitting guides. They do not replace PNG alpha or crop the character. Always sample the original full-resolution texture once; feet and sword contact markers are constraints.

notes: PNG files are copied unchanged from built-in imagegen. Alpha QA is based on actual RGBA. Full-body contain rect is measured strong alpha (>38/255) plus three pixels; full canvas texture retains natural soft alpha edges. No image thresholding or pixel editing was performed. Root performs native warm-stage compositing verification; these are single illustrations, not new animation frame sequences.
